insights.headline: MCX gold and silver slip ahead of Diwali; WGC reports weak India Q3 demand but strong central-bank buying
insights.summary: Gold and silver extended their slide on the MCX in Tuesday's session, with gold futures down about Rs 1,400 per 10 grams and silver off roughly Rs 4,300 per kg, as lingering US rate-hike bets weighed on the metals ahead of Diwali. The World Gold Council's Q3 report showed India's gold demand down 29% year on year to 162.5 tonnes on record-high prices, while central banks bought 321 tonnes and gold ETFs added 211 tonnes. Jewellers say the price dip is reviving festive and wedding buying.
points: MCX gold futures fell ~Rs 1,400/10g and silver ~Rs 4,300/kg in Tuesday's trade as US rate-hike expectations lingered (Economic Times).
India's Q3 gold demand fell 29% to 162.5 tonnes on record-high prices; WGC sees 2026 demand at a six-year low (Reuters).
Central banks bought 321 tonnes in Q3 (+42% y/y), the most since Q4 2024; gold ETFs added 211 tonnes, reversing Q2 outflows (WGC).
Jewellers say the price dip is putting the sparkle back into festive and wedding buying ahead of Diwali (Economic Times).
India is set to ramp up silver imports into 2027 as 6,500-tonne permits clear a backlog (Kitco).

trending.title: Diwali-eve dip: MCX under rate-hike pressure
trending.summary: Gold and silver slipped again on the MCX on Tuesday as lingering US rate-hike bets capped the metals, extending a volatile run-up to Diwali even as jewellers report festive buying is picking up.

trending.title: WGC Q3: India demand wilts, official buyers don't
trending.summary: India's Q3 gold demand fell 29% to 162.5 tonnes as record prices and duty squeezed volumes, yet central banks bought 321 tonnes and ETFs added 211 tonnes, keeping global demand near record.

trending.title: Silver's cross-currents: falling prices, rising imports
trending.summary: Silver has fallen harder than gold on the MCX, but India is set to ramp up silver imports into 2027 as 6,500-tonne permits clear a backlog — physical demand and futures prices are diverging.

trending.title: Festive buying adapts to high prices
trending.summary: With gold far above last year's levels, jewellery brands are reworking festive pitches, quick-commerce coin buying is drawing scrutiny, and buyers lean on lighter designs and exchange offers.

items.title: MCX gold prices fall Rs 1,400/10 gram, silver tanks Rs 4,300/kg ahead of Diwali while rate hike bets linger. What should you do?
items.summary: Gold futures on the MCX slipped about Rs 1,400 per 10 grams and silver futures tumbled roughly Rs 4,300 per kg in Tuesday's session ahead of Diwali, with expectations of further US rate hikes keeping pressure on the metals. The report notes the slide comes during peak festive buying and walks through the factors Indian buyers are weighing.

items.title: Central bank buying and ETF inflows support gold demand in Q3
items.summary: Central banks bought a net 321 tonnes of gold in Q3 2026, up 42% year on year and the strongest quarter since late 2024, taking January-September purchases to 675 tonnes. The WGC now expects full-year official buying to at least match 2025's 848 tonnes. Gold-backed ETFs added 211 tonnes, reversing Q2 outflows, while bar-and-coin demand fell 19% and total Q3 demand was 1,369 tonnes.

items.title: Silver prices crash ₹8,500/kg, gold drops ₹2,000/10g as US-Iran tensions revive inflation fears; is more fall ahead?
items.summary: December silver futures on MCX resumed their losing streak on Tuesday after reports of a US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island sent crude higher, reviving inflation fears and rate-hike expectations. Silver futures slipped ₹8,528 per kg to their lowest since late November 2025, while gold fell ₹2,000 per 10 grams, erasing Monday's brief rebound.

items.title: Gold, silver rates today, November 3: Prices fall ahead of Dhanteras, Diwali; Check 22K, 24K gold rates in your city
items.summary: MCX December gold futures traded at ₹1,38,552 per 10 grams, down ₹1,634 (1.17%) from ₹1,40,186; December silver fell ₹5,878 (3.2%) to ₹1,77,901 per kg. Retail 24-karat gold stood near ₹1,39,530 and 22-karat at ₹1,27,910. Citing the WGC's November 2 Weekly Markets Monitor, the piece blames shifting US Fed rate expectations and leveraged-investor selling, with silver under greater pressure.

items.title: Gold eases ahead of US midterm elections
items.summary: Spot gold fell 0.5% to $3,926.52 an ounce by 0353 GMT after a 2%+ rebound, as investors awaited the US midterm results; December futures dropped 0.8% to $3,936.30. KCM Trade's Tim Waterer said gold stays in consolidation mode and is being sold to cover losses elsewhere rather than bought as a haven. Traders see a 74% December Fed-hike chance (CME FedWatch); spot silver slipped 1.8% to $49.71.

items.title: All That Glitters Is Not Gold, Nor Silver
items.summary: An analysis of the bullion correction: MCX silver fell about 57% from ₹4,20,048/kg (Jan 29) to ~₹1,78,900/kg (Oct 30); gold dropped about 23% from ₹1,80,779 to ₹1,38,419/10g. Silver's boom came from structural supply deficits and China's TOPCon solar demand shock, then unwound as Chinese buying cooled. Indian gold ETF assets rose from ₹344.55 billion to ₹1.73 trillion since July 2024.

items.title: India's tax hike drives illegal gold imports to 3-year high
items.summary: The World Gold Council says India's informal gold imports surged more than 1,500% to 50 tonnes in the September quarter, from 3 tonnes a year earlier, the highest since 2023, citing Metals Focus data. The grey market has flourished since May's duty hike to 15%, and jewellers are holding back on restocking ahead of Diwali while more households buy for cash without invoices.

items.title: India's 2026 gold demand seen falling to six-year low on price rise
items.summary: India's gold demand is expected to fall to a six-year low in 2026 as elevated prices weigh on jewellery sales and investment demand cools, the World Gold Council said. September-quarter demand fell 29% year-on-year to 162.5 tonnes — jewellery down 20%, investment demand down 40% — dragging full-year demand toward about 650 tonnes, the lowest since 2020.

items.title: Gold Faces $4,000 Test as December Hike Risk Caps the Recovery
items.summary: Spot gold rose $67.90 (+1.8%) to $3,945.70 on Monday, rebounding from Friday's 3.6% crash to $3,869.80, its lowest since October 2025. The bounce is driven by crude, not safe-haven demand: WTI fell 6.28% to $97.58 as Iran signaled it could reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The recovery faces the $4,000 test with December hike odds above 70%, CPI at 3.4% and Friday's jobs report looming.

items.title: Gold rises to near $3,950 as traders brace for US midterm election
items.summary: Gold pushed toward $3,950 in Asian trade Tuesday as a ~7% crude slide on ongoing US-Iran talks tempered inflation worries. Traders are positioning for the US midterms, with polls favoring Democrats to take the House; FXStreet notes renewed deficit fears could lift safe-haven demand. Peter Grant (Zaner Metals) said ~73% December Fed-hike odds (CME FedWatch), down from 80%, still cap conviction.

items.title: Dip in gold price puts the sparkle back into festive and wedding buying, jewellers see 10-12% rise in Dhanteras sales
items.summary: A more than 7% slide in gold prices over the past month — ₹1.37 lakh per 10 gm in Mumbai spot trade, down from ₹1.48 lakh — has revived footfalls and advance bookings ahead of Dhanteras on November 6. IBJA national secretary Surendra Mehta expects Dhanteras sales volume to rise 10–12% year-on-year, with buyers favouring lightweight and lower-karat jewellery.

items.title: India set to ramp up silver imports into 2027 as 6,500-tonne permits clear backlog
items.summary: Heraeus: India's easing silver-import regime should lift consumption over the next two quarters, with permits for ~6,500 tonnes (about 209 moz) over six months -- nearly 90% of 2025's total imports. Monthly imports fell to ~1 moz in May-June under licence rules, then recovered to 15.5 moz in August. Gold is also seeing renewed buying below $4,000, though Fed-hike bets still hang over the metal.

items.title: Gold, silver rebound as Iran diplomacy sends oil lower, easing Fed tightening concerns
items.summary: Spot gold climbed 1.8% to about $3,946 an ounce and silver 3.7% to $50.94 on Monday as renewed US-Iran diplomacy pushed crude down more than 4%, easing inflation fears. Iran said it could reopen the Strait of Hormuz and resume nuclear talks within two days; WTI fell below $100 and Brent toward $108.55. Kitco notes ~75% December Fed-hike odds still cap conviction.

items.title: Gold, silver outlook: Why analysts remain cautious despite Monday's recovery
items.summary: Gold and silver staged a tentative rebound on MCX on Monday after Friday's 3.7% rout, with December gold futures near ₹1.38 lakh per 10 grams and spot gold up 0.6% to about $3,899 an ounce; silver rose 1.3% to $49.76. Analysts at Lemonn and Bonanza told CNBC TV18 it is too early to call a bottom — prices must stop printing lower daily lows and reclaim short-term moving averages first.

items.title: Dhanteras 2026: How to buy gold coins on quick-commerce apps and what to check
items.summary: Ahead of Dhanteras on November 6, quick-commerce apps including Swiggy Instamart, Zepto and Blinkit are selling gold and silver coins with festive offers and EMI options, CNBC-TV18 reports. Buyers should verify the coin's purity and the seller's authenticity, compare the final price with prevailing rates, read the offer terms and buyback policy, and keep the delivery invoice.

items.title: Dhanteras: How jewellery brands are reworking festive pitch amid high gold prices
items.summary: Gold about 9% costlier than last Dhanteras has jewellery brands pitching lighter designs, natural diamonds and lower-karat collections over metal weight. PNGS, Birdhichand Ghanshyamdas and JGP lean on personalised engagement and digital storytelling, while WGC data shows H1 2026 jewellery volumes down 17% as value rose 40%.

items.title: AMC's undercover buy leads to fake silver foil bust
items.summary: AMC health inspectors traced failed rapid-test sweets from a Memco-area handcart to H M Warakhwala, a Kalupur gold-and-silver-foil shop; an inspector's undercover buy failed the purity test and the shop was sealed. Officers seized 170 packets of fake silver foil (10 leaves each, Rs 250/packet; Rs 42,500 total) for lab testing — a caution for Diwali sweet buyers.

items.title: Gold is 20% off its peak this Dhanteras, but jewellery stocks know something buyers don't
items.summary: Gold sits about 20% below its January record ahead of Dhanteras on November 6, yet remains roughly 8% costlier than last year's Dhanteras, while most listed jewellers are still in the green for the year. Jewellers earn on sale value, not weight: Titan and Kalyan posted strong quarterly updates on studded jewellery and lighter designs. Spot gold fell about 4% on Friday to near $3,875 an ounce.

items.title: SGB 2021-22 Series VII investors set for 200%+ gains as RBI fixes premature redemption at Rs 14,167
items.summary: RBI has fixed the premature redemption price for Sovereign Gold Bond 2021-22 Series VII at Rs 14,167 per unit, with the early-exit window due on November 2, 2026 — five years after the tranche was issued at Rs 4,765 per gram (Rs 4,715 for online buyers). Investors redeeming now lock in an absolute capital gain of about 200.5%, over and above the 2.5% annual interest the bonds paid.

items.title: Muthoot Finance rebounds, up 9% from 52-week low as stock reacts to Q2 nos
items.summary: Shares of gold-loan major Muthoot Finance traded about 9% above their 52-week low, reacting to the company's second-quarter results. The rebound comes amid a sharp fall in gold prices that has kept the spotlight on lenders whose collateral values are tied to bullion.

items.title: Gold's slide to one-year low: margin calls amplified a fall driven by Fed hike bets
items.summary: Gold's drop below $3,900 on Friday — more than 3% to a one-year low — was amplified by forced selling as a tech rout triggered margin calls, Commerzbank noted. Oil-fed inflation and ~70-75% odds of a December Fed hike remain the bigger drag; the bank expects metals to recover once leverage clears, with US jobs on Nov 6 and inflation on Nov 10 the next tests.

items.title: Gold And Silver Prices See A Big Drop In October: Is Dhanteras The Right Time To Buy?
items.summary: News18's Business Desk recaps October's sharp MCX correction — gold futures fell nearly Rs 7,800 per 10 grams over the month while silver lost around Rs 44,840 per kg — framing the slide as pre-festive relief for buyers and asking whether the Dhanteras window makes this the right time to step in.

items.title: Crash! Gold price suffers worst October in years: Did silver and platinum suffer too? Check monthly performance
items.summary: Mint's monthly review: gold logged its worst October in years, sinking to a one-year low near $3,876 an ounce, while silver and platinum suffered too — silver slipped below $50 for the first time in nearly a year and platinum hit a 13-month low. The piece traces the selloff to hot US inflation data, Fed rate-hike bets and a broader market rout.
